title: Hex project metadata with no licence list
description: mix.exs declares an application that declares no licence for what it ships. An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads an application that declares no licence for what it ships.
remediation: Record the licence class the project actually ships under, or stop depending on the component until it is known. Specifically: fix an application that declares no licence for what it ships.
limitation: It matches an application that declares no licence for what it ships in the parsed mix.exs; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
